units.source_text: 如果这女孩子年龄更大些，懂得嫉妒了，

en.t: If this girl were a little older and understood jealousy,

units.source_text: 那么两人之间一旦发生不快之事，

en.t: then whenever some unpleasantness arose between the two of them,

units.source_text: 男的便会担心女的是否有所误解而心怀醋意，

en.t: the man would worry that the woman had misunderstood something and was feeling jealous,
and because of that he would become distant from her.

units.source_text: 女的也会对男的怀抱怨恨，

en.t: The woman, too, would come to harbor resentment toward the man,

units.source_text: 因而引起疏远、离异等意外之事。

en.t: and this could lead to unexpected troubles such as estrangement or separation.

units.source_text: 但是现在这两人之间无需此种顾忌，

en.t: But now there was no need for such caution between these two,

units.source_text: 竟是一对快乐的游戏伴侣。

en.t: and they were simply a pair of happy playmates.

units.source_text: 再说，如果这孩子是亲生女儿，

en.t: Besides, if this child had been his own daughter,

units.source_text: 那么到了这年龄，做父亲的也不便肆意地亲近她，

en.t: then at her age even a father could not freely be so intimate with her,
or sleep and rise together with her.

units.source_text: 但是现在这紫儿又并非亲生女儿，

en.t: But as things were, this Murasaki was not his own daughter,
so there was no need for that kind of restraint.

units.source_text: 源氏公子竟把她当作一个异乎寻常的秘藏女儿。

en.t: Prince Genji treated her as an extraordinary, treasured daughter kept close to him.
